comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Small rural Alaska hydro/diesel electric utility with large telephone and broadband operations; no gas distribution, so the mix differs.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Upstream gas producer selling commodities at market prices, not a rate-regulated utility with retail customers.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Mainly gas distribution, pipelines and propane, with a small electric business and no generation. The overlap with Avista is partial.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Regulated electric and gas delivery utility serving residential, commercial and government customers under state commissions and FERC.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Regulated water and wastewater utility; different product and economics from electric and gas utilities.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Single coal plant selling wholesale power and capacity; unregulated merchant generator with no retail distribution.

comps.label: C7
comps.reason: Gas-only distribution plus wholesale energy marketing, storage and solar; no electric generation or delivery.

comps.label: C8
comps.reason: Small gas-only distribution utility with no electric generation or delivery, unlike Avista's integrated electric and gas business.

comps.label: C9
comps.reason: Unregulated retail propane and fuel oil distributor with HVAC services; not a rate-regulated wires and pipes utility.

comps.label: C10
comps.reason: Regulated vertically integrated electric utility with generation, transmission and distribution to retail and wholesale customers, like Avista's electric side.
